title: bodhavilasa — bodh-p03-v21
question: By power of true reflection thus, always, who practices — he, liberated from all bonds, full of eternal bliss, becomes.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). By power of true reflection thus, always, who practices — he, liberated from all bonds, full of eternal bliss, becomes.

premises.text: sadvimarśabalenaivaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pariśīlate sa muktaḥ sarvabandhebhyo nityānandamayo bhavet cidvahnir grasate so 'yaṃ suprabuddho 'sty asau yadā tadāsau vimalo jñeyaś cidvahniḥ sarvabhakṣakaḥ etadbalena saṃyukto yogī nirvāṇalakṣaṇaḥ padaṃ prāpnoti vimalaṃ so 'cirān nātra saṃśayaḥ cidvahnir balalābhe 'pi viśvam ābhāti cinmayam svānandāmṛtakallolam etad ucchalitaṃ bahiḥ tad eva śyānatāṃ yātaṃ bhāvarūpair vibhāvyate svātmā maheśvaro devaḥ krīḍate parameśvaraḥ iti yaḥ satataṃ vetti sa mukto mocayaty api sattvavrātaṃ kṣaṇenaiva ghorāt saṃsārabandhanāt yaḥ kaścit ānandabalaḥ sa svarūpapadasthitaḥ iti yasya samullāsollāsitodayaśālinaḥ tasya svarūpaniṣṭhasya vyutthāne 'pi tad arthyate etat prayatnasāmārthyāj janair evādhigamyate madhyadhāmavikāsāc ca cidānandāt prakāśate tatprakāśād divyadṛṣṭir jñānarūpā vibhāvyate nirmalā suprabhā śuddhā nityānandamayī parā nirdehacchedajālāpi jñānadṛṣṭir vijṛmbhate
